title: Mini Pink Dew Gel Cleanser
descriptionHtml:
What it is: A pH-balanced, non-drying foaming gel cleanser that gently removes oil and targets impurities—leaving the skin soft and refreshed.

Skin Type: Dry and Combination

Skincare Concerns: Dullness

Formulation: Gel

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Coconut-Based Surfactants: Plant-derived surfactants lift away dirt and oil without stripping.
- Coconut Water and Cherry Extract: Support skin’s glow and leave it feeling clean, soft, and replenished.
- B-Vitamin Complex: Vitamin-powered complex retains moisture and promotes skin health.

Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan and cruelty-free.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Dispense into palm, add water, and work into a foamy lather.
-Pro tip: For a richer lather, add more water.
Ingredients+
-Coconut-Based Surfactants: Plant-derived surfactants lift away dirt and oil without stripping.
-Coconut Water and Cherry Extract: Support skin’s glow and leave it feeling clean, soft, and replenished.
-B-Vitamin Complex: Vitamin-powered complex retains moisture and promotes skin health.

Water/Aqua/Eau, Glycerin, Decyl Glucoside, Polyacrylate Crosspolymer-6, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Fruit Water, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Disodium Cocoamphodiacetate, 1,2-Hexanediol, Pentylene Glycol, Prunus Avium (Sweet Cherry) Fruit Extract, Panthenol, Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate, Sodium Chloride, Tocopherol, Hydroxyacetophenone, Butylene Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Sodium Phytate, Fragrance/Parfum, Hexylene Glycol, Cyanocobalamin, Citric Acid.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
